integrity: The mathematical result is supported by a finite uniform-permutation argument and beta-order-statistic identities. Exact rational finite enumerations independently check labelled-state and count-state boundary cases; enumeration is not substituted for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixation probabilities rely on uniformly random sequential vertex selections and current-opinion retention at ties; no result is asserted for random tie coins, nonuniform selection rates or missing cross-edges.
No formula for the full absorption-time law is established.
The primary literature comparison does not rule out unindexed or differently formulated precedents; independent external validation has not been performed.
title: Exact consensus-selection law and odd-community neutrality in asynchronous bipartite majority dynamics
